highlights: Historische Festungsanlage an der Via Claudia Augusta
tipps: Ein gemütlicher Spaziergang um den Fernsteinsee eröffnet herrliche Blicke auf Schloss Fernstein und die bewaldeten Berge.
kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Fernstein on the Fernpass near Nassereith combines historic fortress architecture along the ancient trade route with the natural idyll of emerald-green Fernsteinsee.
beschreibung:
Historic Valley Fortress at the Fernpass

The castle grounds of Schloss Fernstein are picturesquely situated on the southern ramp of the Fernpass road within the municipality of Nassereith. Established during the Middle Ages as a customs station and road barrier, the fortress secured the vital Alpine crossing of the Via Claudia Augusta for centuries.

Emerald-Green Waters and Sigmundsburg Ruin

Right at the foot of the castle lie the crystal-clear waters of Fernsteinsee. On an island in the middle of the lake rise the romantic ruins of Sigmundsburg, once erected by Archduke Sigmund der Münzreiche as a hunting lodge.
